items.title: Extract buildDoneChecklist and DONE row assembly into core/done-oracle.ts
items.context: Create packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts and move buildDoneChecklist + DoneCheckRow type + doneCheckRow factory + all private DONE row-builder helpers out of story-advance.ts into it. This is a mechanical relocation — the function body, row order, blocking semantics, and all gate logic stay byte-identical. Keep imports clean (loadConfig / resolveWorkflowPolicy / declared-artifact-gate / evidence-freshness / dirty-gate etc. follow the function).
items.userSees: A framework maintainer opens packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts and finds buildDoneChecklist + DoneCheckRow + doneCheckRow plus every private DONE row-builder helper there. story-advance.ts no longer contains the buildDoneChecklist function body (line count drops ~569). `npm --prefix packages/main run build` is clean with no circular-import error.

happy.desc: core/done-oracle.ts exists and exports buildDoneChecklist + DoneCheckRow + doneCheckRow; build is clean

edge.desc: every private helper buildDoneChecklist depends on is moved too — done-oracle.ts does NOT import from handlers/story-advance.js (no circular import, preMortem #2)

adversarial.desc: the relocated function body is byte-identical — row order, status, blocking, label logic unchanged (mechanical move only)

verificationEvidence.note: core/done-oracle.ts created and exports buildDoneChecklist + DoneCheckRow + doneCheckRow; npm run build (tsc) is clean.

assertDoneOracleSameSource asserts done-oracle.ts import lines contain no story-advance reference (circular-import guard); npm run build clean confirms no cycle. All private helpers (checkEvidenceFreshness/readGitStatusLines/classifierOptionsForCheck/evaluateDirtyGitStatus/gitRefExists/gitRefContainsMain/checkMainDivergence) moved.

Function body relocated byte-identical; assertDoneChecklistUsesStableOracleRows + assertDeclaredArtifactDoneCommittedRow (unchanged smoke) still pass, plus assertDoneOracleSameSource baseline asserts row id/status/blocking shape.

items.title: Rewire story-advance.ts and session.ts to consume buildDoneChecklist from done-oracle.ts
items.context: story-advance.ts:1127 (DONE gate) and session.ts:789 (session_brief DONE pre-check) currently import buildDoneChecklist from story-advance.ts. Repoint both to core/done-oracle.ts. DONE gate behavior must stay fully compatible — same rows, same order, same blocking decisions. story-advance.ts keeps only a thin re-export if external callers / tests depend on the old path.
items.userSees: story-advance.ts (DONE gate) and session.ts (session_brief DONE pre-check) both import buildDoneChecklist from core/done-oracle.js. Running koala validate / story_advance --phase=DONE / koala session_brief produces the exact same DONE checklist rows as before — same rows, same order, same blocking decisions.

happy.desc: story-advance.ts:1127 DONE gate and session.ts:789 session_brief both import buildDoneChecklist from core/done-oracle.js

edge.desc: a regression snapshot of buildDoneChecklist rows (id/status/blocking/label) for representative story states is byte-identical before vs after the move (preMortem #1)

adversarial.desc: if a thin re-export is kept in story-advance.ts for legacy test imports, it forwards to done-oracle.ts — there is exactly one implementation, no copy

verificationEvidence.note: story-advance.ts DONE gate imports buildDoneChecklist/renderDoneChecklist from ../core/done-oracle.js; session.ts session_brief imports buildDoneChecklist+DoneCheckRow from ../core/done-oracle.js; flow-stability-smoke.ts also repointed.

assertDoneOracleSameSource baseline block asserts buildDoneChecklist row id/status/blocking for a TEST-phase fixture; preexisting assertDoneChecklistUsesStableOracleRows snapshot still byte-identical after the move.

story-advance.ts keeps a thin re-export (export { buildDoneChecklist, type DoneCheckRow } from ../core/done-oracle.js); assertDoneOracleSameSource asserts story-advance.ts has NO export function buildDoneChecklist( implementation — exactly one impl in done-oracle.ts.

items.title: Add a contract test proving DONE gate and session_brief render from the same done-oracle source
items.context: Add a contract/smoke assertion that the DONE gate (story_advance) and session_brief both call the same done-oracle buildDoneChecklist and render identical rows for the same story state — no divergent re-implementation. Existing DONE checklist smoke (flow-stability-smoke declared-artifacts-committed coverage etc.) must continue to pass unchanged.
items.userSees: A contract test drives both the DONE gate path and the session_brief path against the same story fixture and asserts the rendered DONE rows are identical, plus a static check that both files import from core/done-oracle.js. The existing DONE checklist smoke (flow-stability declared-artifacts-committed coverage) passes unchanged. koala validate shows the new contract assertion pass.

happy.desc: contract test drives DONE gate and session_brief against one story fixture and asserts identical rendered rows

edge.desc: contract includes a static check that both story-advance.ts and session.ts import from core/done-oracle.js — same-source proven structurally not just behaviorally (preMortem #3)

adversarial.desc: existing DONE checklist smoke (flow-stability declared-artifacts-committed etc.) passes unchanged — no test had to be weakened to accommodate the move

verificationEvidence.note: assertDoneOracleSameSource drives the DONE gate path (buildDoneChecklist+renderDoneChecklist) and the real session_brief handler against one TEST-phase fixture and asserts identical rendered DONE rows.

assertDoneOracleSameSource includes static grep that both story-advance.ts and session.ts import buildDoneChecklist from ../core/done-oracle.js, plus a no-circular-import check on done-oracle.ts import lines (preMortem #2/#3).
Existing DONE checklist smoke assertDoneChecklistUsesStableOracleRows and assertDeclaredArtifactDoneCommittedRow were not modified and still pass; flow-stability-smoke prints ✓ passed.
